verdict_reason: The only change renames an e2e link to a test title that does not exist in ins-tests PR #138 at 9c67c82, so the coverage claim on SCN-CONSIGN-ADDR-002-A points at nothing.

todos.issue: The e2e link on SCN-CONSIGN-ADDR-002-A names test 'the picker searches within the role, and the row ticked is the one that saves, named above the results on reopening and checked once its page is shown', but no such test exists: in trade-imports-ins-tests PR #138 at 9c67c82 (the PR head), tests/animals/e2e/features/address-book/addresses-picker.spec.ts:52 is still titled 'the picker searches within the role, lists every match on one page, and the row ticked is the one that saves, shown checked on reopening with nothing between the search box and the results heading'. The PR diff renames two other titles in that file, not this one, and the live repos/ clone has no such title either. The link points at a title nobody wrote, so the coverage claim cannot be traced or re-run by title.
todos.fix: Must: the e2e link's test string matches, character for character, the title of a test in addresses-picker.spec.ts at the ins-tests PR head, and that test still asserts the consignor inset text and Change reopening the picker headed Consignor. One way: rename the ins-tests test at line 52 to the new title in PR #138 (its old title also claims 'lists every match on one page', which this ticket makes untrue), or revert this link and the matching one in openspec/coverage/live-animals/addresses/coverage.json to the existing title.
